statements.statement: Luis, operations manager
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Dana named Luis as day-to-day owner.

statements.statement: We want AI to take paperwork off your plate. We want to protect families, students and donors...
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Matches the staff hope for less paperwork and leadership worries about leaks and errors.

statements.statement: All staff, volunteers, contractors and board members.
statements.label: default
statements.reason: Call is silent; template default coverage.

statements.statement: Microsoft Copilot: Pilot users (eight licenses): donor names and gift amounts. No case file or student information.
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Luis described the eight-license pilot and its donor data use.

statements.statement: ChatGPT: Work email only. Nothing about a real person goes in.
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Dana said anyone can use ChatGPT for work with no real person info, via work email.

statements.statement: New tools: Luis approves any new tool, plugin, AI agent or AI feature in software we own. Anything touching client data also needs Grace
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Dana said Luis approves tools; Luis and Grace for client data.

statements.statement: Accounts: Use your work email, and turn off any setting that trains on what you type.
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Dana said exactly this.

statements.section: What you can use AI for
statements.statement: Anyone may use ChatGPT or Copilot for work with no information about a real person in it.
statements.label: contradicts
statements.reason: Copilot is licensed only to eight pilot users, so 'anyone' can't use it; say anyone may use ChatGPT, and Copilot for licensed pilot users.

statements.section: What you can use AI for
statements.statement: Everyone: reword an email, brainstorm, or explain a form.
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Dana listed these uses.

statements.section: What you can use AI for
statements.statement: Teachers: lesson plans, reading passages, GED practice questions, and Spanish handout translations. No student names or scores.
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Priya and Dana described these uses and limits.

statements.section: What you can use AI for
statements.statement: Copilot pilot users (development team and Luis): draft appeals and thank-you letters with donor names; summarize grant guidelines.
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Luis described these pilot uses.

statements.statement: AI-drafted text in county contract reports or funder grant reports — Your manager
statements.label: default
statements.reason: Call flagged county reports as risky without naming an approver; manager is the default.

statements.statement: Any AI use with client data — Luis and Grace
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Dana said client data needs Luis and Grace.

statements.statement: Case files (county contract): names, addresses, income, immigration status, domestic violence, mental health and substance use notes.
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Luis listed these and the county confidentiality section.

statements.statement: Student records (district agreement): names, grades, scores, attendance. Donor notes. Staff files. Passwords and login details.
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Covered by the data-sharing agreement and Luis's list; passwords are always protected.

statements.statement: Installing a browser plugin that reads your email.
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Luis said no to this plugin.

statements.statement: Using AI to score intake essays or place adult students in class levels.
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Priya said she is not comfortable; this is a rejection, not a formal ban.

statements.statement: AI-written public statements about the news, or an AI photo passed off as one of our families.
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Luis wants a person writing statements; Dana called the AI photo a line.

statements.statement: A person reads everything AI helps write... Check county report numbers against our records. The sender is responsible.
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Follows from Dana's concern about audited numbers and false statistics.

statements.statement: AI never decides who gets emergency assistance funds. Caseworkers and their supervisor decide. AI may only help with wording or ideas.
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Dana said this; the wording-help allowance is a general default.

statements.statement: A person signs thank-you letters. Label materials AI helped make, like reading passages. Answer funders honestly when they ask about AI.
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Dana and Priya said each of these.

statements.statement: Tell Luis and Grace the same day. For client data, Grace decides if it is a breach. Reporting a mistake is expected, not punished.
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Luis said this; no-punishment matches staff fear and template.

statements.statement: Luis keeps this policy current and runs an hour of training. The board approves changes. We review it in 12 months.
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Dana said these; 12-month review is the default.

statements.statement: Should we buy ChatGPT Team, extend Copilot to everyone, or neither?
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Dana called it an undecided board budget question.

statements.statement: May AI help with case notes, and what does the county allow?
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Dana is not ready and does not know county rules.

statements.statement: Will we approve Canva's AI image tools, which communications uses now?
statements.label: supported
statements.reason: Canva use was unofficial and not decided.

statements.statement: Will the board say AI is not a step toward cutting positions?
statements.label: unsupported
statements.reason: Staff raised the worry, but the call never asked the board to decide this; reword as a staff concern or drop it.

missed: Bloomerang's possibly built-in AI features are not mentioned as something to keep off until approved.
Ways to handle the Copilot extension to non-pilot staff are not stated, only left as a budget question.
Immigration status of students and undocumented status are not named under student information.
Staff unofficial and personal ChatGPT accounts (free or paid on own card) are not addressed; staff should move to work email.
Donor personal notes from major gift conversations are not specified as Copilot limits.
